title: PICO-8 Lua Language Server

title: Eisha — Video Player with Sound
description: Play MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM and MKV videos with sound in an editor tab. Formats VS Code cannot play, such as AAC sound, are converted while they play. Works with or without ffmpeg installed.
